title: Grant digest is computed from argv before the interpreter path is resolved
label: LIKELY
assumption: The agent can replace the script file between grant and exec, which it can at user privilege.
permits: A grant whose digest covers argv only, while the executed file is resolved later.
reach: An agent swaps the script between the grant and the exec; the grant still matches.
smallest_fix: Include the resolved executable's content hash in the digest and re-check at the OS control point.

closure_proposal.detail: Race test: swap the script between grant and exec; expect DENY.

verifier.reason: No re-check binds the grant to the opened file.
The exec path reads the script after the digest check.
